thread:
alex: Quick hold up — we need to pick facilitators for the ARB rotation next month. proposing 2-week slots instead of 4 to spread load. thoughts?

maria: 2-week sounds good to me. less chance of burnout. :thumbsup:

li: +1 for 2-weeks. also can we standardize a 15m prep handover doc? makes transitions smoother.

alex: yes — that's the ask. i sketched a tiny template, paste below. want to lock Tue 9am PST as the slot?

alex: ```Agenda seed (15m prep + 45m meeting)
- quick roll call + blocker ping (5)
- RFC triage (20) - slot owners callouts
- platform standards backlog (10)
- canary / hot rollout reviews (10)
- action items + owners (5)
```

nina: Tue 9am works for me. can we add a short blameless postmortem check for any production regressions? 5m at end?

sam: Tue 9am is hard for me on alternate weeks. can we allow remote attendance via recorded notes + async votes?

alex: yes — hybrid OK. if you can't make it, drop your vote in the agenda doc before the meeting and we'll count it.

maria: i'll take week 1 of next month for facilitation if no objections. i'll own pre-reads + sending calendar. :raised_hands:

li: i'll take the following 2-week slot. i'll also curate the RFC shortlist (please ping me w/ high-priority PRs).

nina: happy to cover the week after li.

sam: i can be backup for the last week, and i'll maintain the rollout watchlist (alerts + owners).

alex: sweet — so tentative rota: maria, li, nina, sam (2-week each). i'll ask ops to create a shared "ARB-facilitator" calendar with ownership tags.

meeting-bot: calendar event created: "ARB — Architecture Review Board" Tue 09:00 PST recurring biweekly. Event link: https://calendar.company/evt/ARB-1943

maria: thanks — i'll populate agenda doc now: https://docs.company/arb-agenda-seed (please add 1-2 items max to keep it tight)

li: quick note — for RFC triage, can we add a slot for "accept/decline/proceed-to-design" so decisions are explicit? saves followups.

alex: good idea. include a decision column in the agenda template.

sam: can we set a hard 50m meeting cap? overtime kills next meetings.

alex: agreed. 50m cap, 5m rollover at most if urgent. i'll update the invite.

nina: also, can facilitators mark a label on RFC PRs like `arb-ready` so we have an easy filter?

maria: done — added `arb-ready` convention in the doc and the repo CONTRIBUTING.md.

alex: ok team, action items: maria create calendar + agenda pre-read (due 48h prior), li triage RFC shortlist (48h), nina maintain postmortem check notes, sam maintain rollout watchlist. i'll send the rota confirmation to eng-all once calendar is good.

maria: will do.

li: noted. i'll start pulling RFCs today.

meeting-bot: Reminder set: agenda pre-read due 48 hours before next meeting.

alex: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for facilitator swaps. if anyone needs to swap, ping here with new dates.

sam: one more — can we rotate not only facilitation but also note-taker? less cognitive load on one person.

maria: good call. i'll add a note-taker rota in the doc (2-week cadence).

alex: perfect. closing loop unless anything else pops up.
